summary: ONEOK filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its $1.0 billion equity distribution agreement and early/pricing results of a cash tender offer for 20 series of its outstanding debt securities under an Offer to Purchase dated August 30, 2026. Amendment No. 1, dated September 15, 2026, reflects a reorganization whereby ONEOK assumed Legacy ONEOK's obligations; BofA Securities is manager and Bank of America, N.A. is forward purchaser. No equity price or premium is stated. Watch take-up, proration, and financing mix between debt repurchase and equity issuance.
